result.stdout:
Description:
  Serves a directory over HTTP: a file manager in a browser, and a WebDAV drive in Finder or Explorer.

Usage:
  shinyhttpserver [<path>] [options]

Arguments:
  <path>  Directory to serve. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

Options:
  -p, --port <port>                            Port to listen on. [default: 8080]
  -a, --address <address>                      Address to bind: an IP, 'any' (all interfaces) or 'localhost'. Defaults to every interface so other devices can reach it. [default: 0.0.0.0]
  --prefix <prefix>                            URL prefix the directory is mounted at. [default: /]
  -m, --allow <read|create|update|delete|all>  Operations to allow: read, create, update, delete, all. Repeatable or comma separated. Read is always allowed. [default: Read]
  -u, --user <user:password>                   Enables basic auth with user:password. Repeat for more than one user.
  --realm <realm>                              Basic auth realm shown in the browser prompt. [default: shinyhttpserver]
  --auth-changes-only                          Leaves reads open and only requires a login for create/update/delete.
  --allow-insecure-auth                        Allows basic auth over unencrypted, non-loopback connections. The password crosses the network in the clear on every request.
  --https                                      Serves over HTTPS with a self-signed certificate generated at startup. Clients will warn about it.
  --tunnel                                     Opens a public pinggy.io tunnel and shares that address instead of the LAN one. Anonymous tunnels stop after 60 minutes.
  --tunnel-token <token>                       A pinggy.io access token, which lifts the 60 minute cap an anonymous tunnel has. Implies --tunnel.
  --hidden                                     Includes dotfiles and hidden files in listings and downloads.
  --max-upload <size>                          Largest accepted upload, e.g. 500k, 64mb, 2gb. [default: 67108864]
  --no-qr                        
[truncated]
